node.statement: For A,B in B_{r_iso}^{icalH}(0), exact unitality and bilinearity give chi_s(A)-chi_s(B)=s*((A-B)+(g_{sJ}(A)-g_{sJ}(B))). The anti-Hermitian projection P_parallel(X)=(X-X^dagger)/2 is contractive because dagger is an isometry, and it kills the Hermitian g-difference while fixing A-B. Thus ||A-B||=||P_parallel(chi_s(A)-chi_s(B))||<=||chi_s(A)-chi_s(B)||.
